title: UUID Validator & Generator
description: Validates UUID strings against RFC 4122 format (versions 1-5, detecting version and variant) and generates new v4 UUIDs. Takes either a UUID string to validate or generates a new UUID; returns parsed fields or a newly generated UUID.

action.description: Whether to validate a UUID string or generate a new one

uuid.description: Required for validate action: the UUID string to validate (case-insensitive, braces allowed)
